stage: Fixed before new robustness predictions or head fits
primary_question: Does the existing frozen PANNs system outperform the mean of three fixed noise-trained CNNs on the same 10 dB Gaussian-corrupted validation clips?
primary_models: Frozen PANNs Cnn14_16k plus existing StandardScaler and logistic head

waveforms.noise: Per-clip zero-mean unit-RMS Gaussian draw, scaled to 10 dB added-noise SNR; no clipping or peak normalization
waveforms.legacy_noise_results: Kept separate; never substituted for new matched predictions

primary_metric: PANNs accuracy at 10 dB minus mean accuracy of three fixed noiseCNNs at 10 dB, in percentage points
secondary_metrics: Clean-to-noisy accuracy loss for each system
Per-fit paired repairs and new errors

head_ablation.question: Effect of adding ReLU to a fixed two-layer classifier on frozen PANNs features
head_ablation.scaler: StandardScaler fit on training embeddings only
head_ablation.checkpoint_rule: Fixed final epoch100; no validation checkpoint selection
head_ablation.selection: No architecture or hyperparameter search; all six fits reported
head_ablation.evaluation: Final clean and same10dB embeddings; no noise input in head training
head_ablation.original_logistic_head: Separate existing optimization/system reference, not a controlled nonlinearity comparison

bootstrap.training_seeds: Average paired fixed-fit differences within clips before source resampling
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on these fitted models, historical validation selection and one noise realization per clip

stop_rule: Complete the fixed two-condition inference and six small head fits; preserve negative results; no score-driven additional conditions or retraining
limitations: All official folds have historical exposure
AudioSet overlap has not been comprehensively excluded
Primary models differ in pretraining,capacity,frontend and training
Matched-head contrast changes the activation in a fixed bottleneck parameterization; it does not prove MLPs universally help or hurt
